name: 20-questions-and-access
description: A builder asks questions from the sample project. The orchestrator answers from the record, decides, and passes a blocking question to the owner. The owner overturns a decision, answers passed-on questions and grants access. A question job misses both attempts, and a question asked after the only orchestrator is removed goes straight to the owner.

body.text: Which report format is in the project brief?
Should the report cover a second sample?

commands.note: The last hold closes, so the holder is offered resume before the next work call.

body.text: Which placeholder label should the sample use?

commands.note: The first attempt misses its queue deadline.
The claimed retry misses its run deadline.

body.text: May the second sample stay in a footnote?
